answer_1.quote: Beyond long-context understanding, long-context modeling is also related to long-form text generation.

answer_2.quote: Metrics We focus on two aspects: generation length and generation quality. We adopt the metrics for length and quality as defined in HelloBench and LongBench-Write. Specifically, S l represents the length score, S q represents the quality score, and S is their average.

answer_3.quote: To save resources and ensure reproducibility of results, we use LLaMA-3.3-70B-Instruct as the judge model, and the inference engine is vLLM.
